== Notes ==
* This skill only recharges [[Resurrection Signet]], [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]] or [[Celestial skill]]s if they were [[disable]]d by another skill (e.g. by [[Distracting Shot]]); it will not recharge them if they were used successfully.
* Assassin's Promise [[Effect stacking|stack]]s and recharges itself.
** Synergizes well with [[Glyph of Sacrifice]] and skills with a long recharge time such as [[Meteor Shower]].
* [[Hero]]es will not cast this skill on targets already hexed with Assassin's Promise, even though it can be stacked (i.e. each [[caster]] will receive the energy gain and skill recharge when the foe dies).

== Trivia ==
* This skill was not available via [[PvE]] until [[Game updates/20060519|an update]] changed the skills of [[Xuekao, the Deceptive]].
